summary: Partner Network Sprint testing (Fase 3, 4, 5, 5.1, 6) — 14/14 backend tests pass, frontend UI verified. One bug found and fixed: GET /api/partner-network/journeys returned 500 due to non-existent column 'title' in design_journeys table — fixed to use 'lifecycle_state, overall_status, project_id'.

minor.issue: BUG FIXED: selected 'title' column which does not exist in design_journeys table — caused 500. Fixed to use lifecycle_state, overall_status, created_at, project_id

integration_issues.issue: Transient 503 (RemoteProtocolError from Supabase) observed occasionally — not a code bug, infrastructure issue. Page loads correctly when stable.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/partner-network/journeys was selecting non-existent 'title' column from design_journeys — FIXED
Status filter for partner_status is done in-memory after DB fetch (because it's in metadata_json) — this is intentional but could be slow at scale
POST /api/partner-network/partners/{id}/assign requires users_profile to exist for the partner email — this is a known design constraint clearly documented
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ partners via POST /api/partner/apply: TEST_Giulia Bianchi, TEST_Luigi Verdi, TEST_NoAccount Check
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner Network sprint fully tested. Bug fixed: GET /api/partner-network/journeys used wrong column 'title' (doesn't exist) — now uses lifecycle_state. Backend 14/14 pass. Frontend UI verified: /partner-application form works, /partner-network page loads with table, filters, sidebar icon. Marco Ferretti (259f4645) is approved partner for testing AssignDJ flow. Supabase transient 503s are infrastructure issue not code bugs.
rca_of_issue: GET /api/partner-network/journeys 500: The design_journeys table was created without a 'title' column (uses project_id FK for display). The partner_network.py router incorrectly assumed a 'title' column existed. Fix: select 'id, lifecycle_state, overall_status, created_at, project_id' instead.
